author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: EmunaEliran
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: entire chat history exfiltrated. Check Point bypassed Lockdown Mode's prompt injection protections via the HTML preview sandboxed iframes.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes vulnerability patched! AI agents could access host files via prompt injection. Update to v0.51.0 now. CVE-2026-103916

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Attackers exploit the GPUStack authentication bypass CVE-2026-102895 in the wild. Update to 2.2.2 now to fix this flaw and CVE-2026-102894.

author: ZeroAgencyAI
text: Asked your agent for 'a GitHub MCP'? It may have picked Anthropic's archived one from memory. No fixes coming. Puppeteer's MCP server has an RCE via prompt injection.

author: baoge808
text: 98% of coding-agent sessions install archived, vulnerable MCP servers on their own (Glow Labs, MCPhantom). 17.3M npm downloads of packages with known RCE via prompt injection.

author: eric_m_freeman
text: Copilot in Edge picked the scammer 20 out of 20 times. Researchers planted one fake review and the agent ruled out the real provider.

author: dd_pwnd
text: LLMjacking: attackers grab cloud AI API keys from leaked code or phishing and run up bills; one company hit for $100,000 in a single day.

author: JNitterauer
text: Todyl and Huntress: an automated operator is replaying stolen credentials to reach MSP Microsoft 365 and Azure tenants and their downstream clients.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Application identity abuse targets MSPs: threat actor authenticates as trusted Azure apps, bypassing MFA, to harvest credentials across multiple customer tenants, ongoing since November 1, 2026.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Attribution: DPRK/Lazarus-nexus.

author: ita_ipo
text: Actively exploited: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977), CISA deadline Nov 6. Apple pointer-auth bypass (CVE-2024-27834) also just hit the KEV list.

author: EHackerNews
text: CISA Warns of Actively Exploited WordPress RCE Flaw

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2024-27834 added to CISA KEV.

author: SmarterMSP
text: A critical Brotli flaw is being actively exploited and could enable remote code execution across a wide range of applications and platforms.

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441).

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Zyxel GS1900 switches: zero-day CVE-2026-107441 exploited on ~1,000 switches, the CVE-2026-7273 fix didn't stop it.

author: Valitron_AB
text: YOOtheme Pro CVE-2026-102785 (CVSS 4.0 10.0): unauthenticated RCE via image handler (5.0.0-5.0.52, fixed in 5.0.53). Unit 42 has seen exploitation in the wild.

author: veenodetech
text: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed around 1,411 flaws; one exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: Prashan76506990
text: Reported a reflected XSS in Laravel's debug error page giving full JavaScript execution. Confirmed unpatched on both 12.x and 13.x (tested on 13.39.0).

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: NTT DOCOMO data breach: unauthorised external access affecting servers supporting DOCOMO Online Shop and My docomo.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Binance and Deribit have revoked API keys connected to SignalPlus following a potential security issue.

author: grisdoteth
text: Binance's $6.34B breach never needed a private key: fake interviews, a signing service that said yes, and EIP 7702 keeping funds moving after withdrawals paused.

author: XBToshi
text: The GitBook incident: attackers compromised documentation, a wake-up call for Web3.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE is suspected of spreading malware enabling remote control.

author: Netwrix
text: Slopsquatting: AI coding assistants invent package names and attackers register them, a supply chain attack.
